data.long_meaning: Gnana is a Sanskrit and Tamil name meaning 'knowledge' or 'wisdom'. This name is deeply rooted in Hinduism and represents the pursuit of knowledge and enlightenment. The name Gnana carries the meaning “Knowledge, Wisdom” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Tamil. Parents who choose Gnana usually hope their child will grow to embody knowledge, wisdom and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Gnana is a name of the Hindu Goddess Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge, music, art, wisdom, and learning. This name is believed to bring blessings of intelligence, creativity, and knowledge.
data.etymology: Gnana belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Knowledge, Wisdom.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gnana total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
